text: The game begins. Seven players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra, Opus. Nobody knows who the killers are.

name: Gemma
text: I can't believe you all actually managed to find Sol and Luna last time.

name: Sonnet

Night 1

Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.

text: I kept pressing Gemma for proof and never once suspected Haiku, the quiet one who just sat there.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku was the hidden killer and never claimed any role or faced scrutiny the entire game.

name: Terra
text: I regret letting Gemma’s messy story distract us from the last killer.

name: Opus
text: I lost my own card but my last breath pointed the table at a citizen, and that lie won it.

name: Haiku
text: I'm the killer who got away with it, and I'm glad Terra and Gemma were the ones I could pin the blame on.

name: Sonnet
text: I regret never pressuring Haiku for a claim at all — I spent every round fixated on Opus and Gemma while the second killer stayed invisible.

name: Haiku
text: I'm proud I kept my cover as a killer long enough to get through two nights, but I regret that my attacks on Gemma and Terra were loud.

name: Gemma
text: I spent my last breath trying to show you Terra was the killer, but you let her take us all down.

name: Sol
text: I regret letting Luna’s officer claim lose to Opus’s bluff; she had named a killer, and we had a chance to turn his card.

name: Luna
text: I regret that my true warning about Opus didn’t survive my day-one vote.

name: Terra
text: I regret not pushing Haiku harder once Opus was gone; Gemma was innocent, and we gave the killer the final path.

name: Opus
text: I burned on day 2, but naming Terra as my partner was the move — the table spent its last day hunting a citizen, and Haiku walked through it.

Luna claimed officer on Day 1 and named Opus as the killer, but Opus counterclaimed officer that same day and named Sol. Luna was voted out on Day 1 by 4 votes to 3, and Sol was killed on Night 2. On Day 2 Opus admitted his claim was a lie and was voted out, but his last words named Terra as his partner. On Day 3 the town tied on Terra and Gemma, and Gemma, the doctor, was voted out in the runoff. Terra was killed on Night 4, leaving Haiku and Sonnet, and the killers won.
